flow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

flow.sentenceEn: You'd think this might fuel the efficiency mind-set, but in fact, Eberle notes, such ritualistic behaviour helps us "step outside time's flow " into "soul time."
flow.translationZh: 你可能会认为这会加剧效率至上的心态，但事实上，埃伯利指出，这种仪式化的行为帮助我们“走出时间的流逝”，进入“灵魂时间”。
flow.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

flow.sentenceEn: The networked computer offers the first chance in 50 years to reverse the flow , to encourage thoughtful downloading and, even more importantly, meaningful uploading.
flow.translationZh: 联网计算机提供了50年来第一个逆转这种流向的机会，它鼓励经过思考的下载，更重要的是，鼓励有意义的上传。

formal.sentenceEn: They pool resources, collaborate, think outside the box, and find solutions and ways around obstacles to explore science for the sake of science without the traditional boundaries of working inside a formal setting.
formal.translationZh: 他们汇聚资源、通力协作、跳出思维定式，在不受正式工作环境传统界限束缚的情况下，为了科学而探索科学，寻找解决问题的方法并克服各种障碍。
formal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

formal.sentenceEn: You don't even need any formal training, just an inquisitive mind and the enthusiasm to join one of the thousands of citizen science projects to generate new knowledge and the means to understand a genuine scientific outcome.
formal.translationZh: 你甚至不需要任何正式培训，只需要一颗好奇的心和参与数千个公民科学项目的热情，就能为新知识的产生贡献力量，并理解真正的科学成果。
formal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

formal.sentenceEn: Yet, reluctance persists among other planners to integrate desire paths into formal plans, citing concerns about safety, environmental impact, or primarily, aesthetics.
formal.translationZh: 然而，其他规划者仍然不愿意将这些"欲望路径"纳入正式规划中，他们提出的理由包括安全隐患、环境影响，或者最主要的是美观问题。
formal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

formal.sentenceEn: No matter how formal or informal the work environment, the way you present yourself has an impact.
formal.translationZh: 无论工作环境多么正式或非正式，你的个人形象都会产生影响。
formal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

formal.sentenceEn: Millennials, it seems, face the paradox of being the least formal generation yet the most conscious of style and personal branding.
formal.translationZh: 千禧一代似乎面临着一个矛盾：他们是最不讲究正式着装的一代，却又是最注重时尚风格和个人品牌塑造的一代。
formal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

formal.sentenceEn: Rather, we ascribe meanings to texts on the basis of interaction between what we might call textual and contextual material: between kinds of organization or patterning we perceive in a text's formal structures (so especially its language structures) and various kinds of background, social knowledge, belief and attitude that we bring to the text.
formal.translationZh: 相反，我们赋予文本意义是基于我们所谓的文本材料与语境材料之间的互动：一方面是我们在文本形式结构（尤其是语言结构）中感知到的各种组织方式或模式，另一方面是我们带入文本的各种背景知识、社会认知、信念和态度。

frequently.sentenceEn: In 2016, researchers developed an algorithm to recognize suspicious citation patterns, including groups of authors that disproportionately cite one another and groups of journals that cite each other frequently to increase the impact factors of their publications.
frequently.translationZh: 2016年，研究人员开发了一种算法来识别可疑的引用模式，包括作者群体间不成比例地相互引用，以及期刊群体间频繁相互引用以提高其出版物影响因子的行为。
frequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

frequently.sentenceEn: Indeed, it was frequently the first stop for merchants looking to sell their wares and stock up on supplies for their own journeys.
frequently.translationZh: 事实上，这里往往是商人们寻找销售商品并为自己的旅程补充 supplies 的第一站。
frequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

frequently.sentenceEn: Efforts in Canada and elsewhere have been arguably languid at best, and have given us a situation where we frequently hear of employers begging for workers, even at times and in regions where unemployment is high.
frequently.translationZh: 加拿大及其他地区在这方面的努力往好了说也只能算是迟缓乏力，这就造成了一种局面：我们常常听到雇主四处招不到工人，即便在失业率居高不下的时期和地区也是如此。
frequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

frequently.sentenceEn: Buses do so almost as frequently as cyclists.
frequently.translationZh: 公交车闯红灯的频率几乎和骑自行车的人一样高。
frequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第12句

frequently.sentenceEn: Even if families don't sit down to eat together as frequently as before, millions of Britons will nonetheless have got a share this weekend of one of that nation's great traditions: the Sunday roast.
frequently.translationZh: 即便家庭成员不像以前那样频繁围坐一起用餐，但数百万英国人本周末仍会共同享用一项国家传统美食：周日烤肉大餐。
frequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

frequently.sentenceEn: It was only after I started to write a weekly column about the medical journals, and began to read scientific papers from beginning to end, that I realised just how bad much of the medical literature frequently was.
frequently.translationZh: 直到我开始撰写一个关于医学期刊的每周专栏，并开始从头到尾阅读科学论文时，我才意识到大量医学文献的质量常常有多糟糕。
frequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

female.sentenceEn: Haddad and Lewis are concerned that more than half the state-government boards are less than 40 percent female .
female.translationZh: 哈达德和刘易斯担心，超过半数的州政府委员会中女性占比不足40%。
female.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

female.sentenceEn: Reding invited corporations to sign up for gender balance goals of 40 per cent female board membership.
female.translationZh: 雷丁呼吁各企业签署承诺书，致力于实现女性在董事会成员中占40%的性别平衡目标。
female.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

female.sentenceEn: If we know female job screeners are more likely to reject attractive female applicants, we can help screeners understand their biases – or hire outside screeners.
female.translationZh: 如果我们知道女性招聘筛选者更可能拒绝有吸引力的女性求职者，我们可以帮助筛选者认识到她们的偏见——或者聘请外部筛选者。
female.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

female.sentenceEn: It was not until the mid-1980s, when amplifying age and sex differences became a dominant children's marketing strategy, that pink fully came into its own, when it began to seem inherently attractive to girls, part of what defined them as female , at least for the first few critical years.
female.translationZh: 直到20世纪80年代中期，当放大年龄和性别差异成为儿童市场的主导营销策略时，粉色才真正盛行起来，并开始对女孩产生一种天生的吸引力，成为定义她们女性身份的一部分，至少在最初关键的几年里是如此。
female.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

female.sentenceEn: The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
female.translationZh: 泰勒案的判决还宣布在陪审团遴选中存在性别歧视是违宪的，并命令各州在遴选男性和女性陪审员时采用相同的程序。
female.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

female.sentenceEn: Studies of both animals and humans have shown that sex hormones somehow affect the stress response, causing females under stress to produce more of the trigger chemicals than do males under the same conditions.
female.translationZh: 对动物和人类的研究都表明，性激素会以某种方式影响应激反应，使处于压力下的雌性比相同条件下的雄性产生更多触发化学物质。
female.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
female.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

finally.sentenceEn: Finally , assuming you're lost in an area humans tend to frequent, look for the marks we leave on the landscape.
finally.translationZh: 最后，假设你在人类常去的区域迷了路，请寻找我们在地面上留下的痕迹。
finally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

finally.sentenceEn: Now comes word that everyone involved – Democrats, Republicans, the Postal Service, the unions and the system's heaviest users – has finally agreed on a plan to fix the system.
finally.translationZh: 现在有消息称，所有相关方——民主党人、共和党人、邮政总局、工会以及邮政系统的最大用户——终于就一项系统改革计划达成了一致。
finally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

finally.sentenceEn: Finally , because automation threatens to widen the gap between capital income and labor income, taxes and the safety net will have to be rethought.
finally.translationZh: 最后，由于自动化可能会扩大资本收入与劳动收入之间的差距，我们必须重新思考税收和社会保障体系。
finally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

finally.sentenceEn: Too often we believe that a new job, bigger house or better car will be the magic silver bullet that will allow us to finally be content, but the reality is these things have very little lasting impact on our happiness levels.
finally.translationZh: 我们常常认为，一份新工作、一栋更大的房子或一辆更好的车会成为那支神奇的"银弹"，让我们最终获得满足。但现实是，这些东西对我们的幸福水平几乎没有持久的影响。
finally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

finally.sentenceEn: We still have a long way to go to get back to full employment, but at least we are now finally moving forward at a faster pace.
finally.translationZh: 要恢复充分就业，我们仍有很长的路要走，但至少现在我们终于在以更快的速度前进。
finally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

finally.sentenceEn: Finally , there is perspective, which involves acknowledging that in the grand scheme of life, one lecture really doesn't matter.
finally.translationZh: 最后是视角调整，这包括认识到在人生的宏大蓝图中，一次演讲真的无关紧要。
finally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

formation.sentenceEn: "The valuable examples which they furnish of the power of self-help, of patient purpose, resolute working, and steadfast integrity, issuing in the formation of truly noble and manly character, exhibit," wrote Smiles, "what it is in the power of each to accomplish for himself."
formation.translationZh: 斯迈尔斯写道：“他们身上所展现的宝贵榜样——自助的力量、坚定的意志、不懈的努力和始终如一的正直品格，最终铸就了真正高尚而有男子气概的人格——展示了每个人都有能力为自己成就一番事业。”
formation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

formation.sentenceEn: Earlier this year the country's Defence Advanced Research Projects Agency announced plans to pay Boeing to investigate formation flight, though the programme has yet to begin.
formation.translationZh: 今年早些时候，美国国防高级研究计划局宣布计划资助波音公司研究编队飞行技术，不过该项目尚未启动。
formation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

formation.sentenceEn: It remains to be seen how weather conditions affect the air flows that make formation flight more efficient.
formation.translationZh: 目前尚不清楚天气状况会如何影响那些使编队飞行更高效的气流。
formation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

formation.sentenceEn: Peter Lissaman, an aeronautics expert who was formerly at Caltech and the University of Southern California, has suggested that a formation of 25 birds might enjoy a range increase of 71%.
formation.translationZh: 彼得·利萨曼是一位航空学专家，曾任职于加州理工学院和南加州大学，他指出25只鸟编队飞行时，航程可能会增加71%。
formation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

formation.sentenceEn: Since 1914, scientists have known that birds flying in formation – a V-shape – expend less energy.
formation.translationZh: 自1914年起，科学家们就已了解到，鸟类以V字形编队飞行时消耗的能量更少。
formation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

formation.sentenceEn: Formation flight is more comfortable because passengers can not see the other planes.
formation.translationZh: 编队飞行更舒适，因为乘客看不到其他飞机。

fundamental.sentenceEn: When you find yourself taking a situation personally, try to think of other interpretations that are less focused on you — especially in the sense of saying anything deep or fundamental about you.
fundamental.translationZh: 当你发现自己对某种情况过于敏感、认为是在针对自己时，试着去寻找其他不那么以你为中心的解释——特别是要意识到，这件事并不代表对你个人深度或本质上的定性。
fundamental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

fundamental.sentenceEn: Today the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) raises fundamental questions: "What is intelligence, identity, or consciousness? What makes humans humans?"
fundamental.translationZh: 如今，人工智能（AI）的迅猛发展引发了一些根本性问题：“何为智能、身份或意识？是什么让人类成为人类？”
fundamental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

fundamental.sentenceEn: Precisely because readers from different historical periods, places and social experiences produce different but overlapping readings of the same words on the page–including for texts that engage with fundamental human concerns – debates about texts can play an important role in social discussion of beliefs and values.
fundamental.translationZh: 正是因为来自不同历史时期、不同地域和不同社会经历的读者会对书页上相同的文字产生既有所不同又相互重叠的解读——包括那些探讨人类基本关切的文本——关于文本的讨论才能在社会对信仰和价值观的探讨中发挥重要作用。
fundamental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

fundamental.sentenceEn: Even the very phrase "jobseeker's allowance" is about redefining the unemployed as a "jobseeker" who had no fundamental right to a benefit he or she has earned through making national insurance contributions.
fundamental.translationZh: 就连"求职者津贴"这一说法本身就在重新定义失业者——将其定义为一名"求职者"，而这名求职者根本无权享有他或她通过缴纳国民保险费所应得的福利。
fundamental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

fundamental.sentenceEn: Many, like the Fundamental Physics Prize, are funded from the telephone-number-sized bank accounts of Internet entrepreneurs.
fundamental.translationZh: 其中许多奖项，如基础物理学奖，其资金来源于互联网企业家们巨额的银行存款。
fundamental.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

fundamental.sentenceEn: Companies find it to be fundamental .

fuel.sentenceEn: These fires were carefully planned and intentionally ignited during periods when weather kept the blazes easy to control, and helped eliminate some of the fuel that had built up around the important park's facilities.
fuel.translationZh: 这些火灾是经过周密计划且有意点燃的。点火时段的天气状况使得火势易于控制，这有助于清除公园重要设施周边积聚的部分易燃物。
fuel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

fuel.sentenceEn: The strategy also aims to ensure that carbon in woody material removed from the forests is locked away in the form of solid lumber or burned as biofuel in vehicles that would otherwise run on fossil fuels .
fuel.translationZh: 该战略还旨在确保从森林中移除的木质材料中的碳以实木 lumber 的形式封存起来，或在原本使用化石燃料的车辆中作为生物燃料燃烧。
fuel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

fuel.sentenceEn: President Trump has underlined fossil fuels – especially coal – as the path to economic growth.
fuel.translationZh: 特朗普总统强调化石燃料——尤其是煤炭——是实现经济增长的途径。
fuel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

fuel.sentenceEn: While fossil fuels – coal, oil, gas – still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply, it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar.
fuel.translationZh: 虽然化石燃料——煤炭、石油、天然气——仍占全球能源供应的约85%，但未来属于风能和太阳能等可再生能源这一点比以往任何时候都更加明确。
fuel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

fuel.sentenceEn: It has been documented that during World War Ⅱ, America's armed forces once tried formation flight to save fuel .
fuel.translationZh: 有记录显示，二战期间美国军队曾尝试编队飞行以节省燃油。

fuel.sentenceEn: Copying Birds May Save Aircraft Fuel
fuel.translationZh: 效仿鸟类飞行或可节省飞机燃油

fairly.sentenceEn: And today, even writers who are fairly well-known often have to do other work to supplement their writing income.
fairly.translationZh: 而如今，即便是颇有名气的作家，也常常需要从事其他工作来补贴写作收入。
fairly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

fairly.sentenceEn: We're fairly good at judging people based on first impressions, thin slices of experience ranging from a glimpse of a photo to five-minute interaction, and deliberation can be not only extraneous but intrusive.
fairly.translationZh: 我们相当擅长根据第一印象来判断他人——这种快速的经验片段可以是匆匆一瞥的照片，也可以是五分钟的互动——而深思熟虑不仅多余，甚至会造成干扰。
fairly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

fairly.sentenceEn: To lead in that system requires knowledge that is fairly mind-boggling.
fairly.translationZh: 要在这样的体系中引领企业，需要的知识量相当惊人。
fairly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

fairly.sentenceEn: If "entitled" is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious.
fairly.translationZh: 如果说“有 entitlement 心态”是人们用来形容千禧一代（1981年至1995年出生的人）最常见的形容词——无论这种说法是否公平——那么Z世代的关键词则是务实和谨慎。
fairly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

fairly.sentenceEn: Yet satisfaction with these material purchases wears off fairly quickly.
fairly.translationZh: 然而，这些物质购买带来的满足感会很快消退。
fairly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

fairly.sentenceEn: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?
fairly.translationZh: 我们是否需要配额制度来确保女性在平衡工作与家庭的同时，能够继续公平地攀登企业晋升阶梯？
fairly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

fulfill.sentenceEn: Traditionally, this role was fulfilled by data banks, libraries, and other humans.
fulfill.translationZh: 传统上，这一角色是由数据库、图书馆和其他人来承担的。
fulfill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

fulfill.sentenceEn: But while young and old mostly agree on what constitutes the finish line of a fulfilling life, they offer strikingly different paths for reaching it.
fulfill.translationZh: 然而，尽管年轻人和老一辈在什么是美满生活的终点这一问题上基本达成共识，但在如何实现这一目标的路径选择上却存在显著差异。
fulfill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

fulfill.sentenceEn: Are we studying that text and trying to respond in a way that fulfills the requirement of a given course? Reading it simply for pleasure? Skimming it for information? Ways of reading on a train or in bed are likely to differ considerably from reading in a seminar room.
fulfill.translationZh: 我们是在学习某篇文本并尝试以满足特定课程要求的方式作答吗？是单纯为了乐趣而阅读？还是为了获取信息而浏览？在火车上或床上的阅读方式可能与在研讨室里的阅读方式有很大不同。
fulfill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

fulfill.sentenceEn: This, though it fulfills the laws and requirements of Futurist poetry, can hardly be classed as Literature.
fulfill.translationZh: 尽管这符合未来主义诗歌的规则和要求，但它很难被归类为文学。
fulfill.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
fulfill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

fulfill.sentenceEn: Ten years ago young people were hardworking and saw their jobs as their primary reason for being, but now Japan has largely fulfilled its economic needs, and young people don't know where they should go next.
fulfill.translationZh: 十年前，年轻人勤奋工作，视职业为自己存在的首要理由，但如今日本已基本满足了经济需求，年轻人却不知道下一步该何去何从。
fulfill.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
fulfill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

fulfill.sentenceEn: It is writers' duty to fulfill journalistic goals.
fulfill.translationZh: 履行新闻事业的使命是作家的职责。

fiction.sentenceEn: Fiction invites you to loiter unseen in the lives of others.
fiction.translationZh: 小说邀请你隐身于他人的生活之中，流连忘返。

fiction.sentenceEn: She draws on letters, diaries and fiction , and a 1939 field notebook of verbatim audience research by Winifred Gill.
fiction.translationZh: 她参考了信件、日记和小说，以及温妮弗雷德·吉尔于 1939 年通过现场调研记录的一本观众研究逐字稿。
fiction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

fiction.sentenceEn: Even before the invention of the electric light bulb, the author produced a remarkable work of speculative fiction that would foreshadow many ethical questions to be raised by technologies yet to come.
fiction.translationZh: 甚至在电灯泡发明之前，这位作者就创作了一部杰出的科幻小说，预示了未来科技将会引发的诸多伦理问题。
fiction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

fiction.sentenceEn: Young people who are digital natives are indeed becoming more skillful at separating fact from fiction in cyberspace.
fiction.translationZh: 作为数字原住民的年轻人，确实越来越擅长在网络空间中辨别事实与虚构。
fiction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

fiction.sentenceEn: And so he reads – everything from encyclopedias to science fiction novels.
fiction.translationZh: 于是他开始博览群书——从百科全书到科幻小说，无所不读。
fiction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

fiction.sentenceEn: The interest in science fiction is on the rise.
fiction.translationZh: 人们对科幻小说的兴趣正在上升。

fishery.sentenceEn: They have looked at half a century of data from fisheries around the world.
fishery.translationZh: 他们研究了全球渔场半个世纪以来的数据。
fishery.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
fishery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

fishery.sentenceEn: That matters because theory suggests that the maximum sustainable yield that can be cropped from a fishery comes when the biomass of a target species is about 50% of its original levels.
fishery.translationZh: 这一点至关重要，因为理论表明，当目标鱼种的生物量保持在原有水平的50%左右时，渔场才能实现最大可持续捕捞量。
fishery.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
fishery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

fishery.sentenceEn: According to their latest paper published in Nature, the biomass of large predators (animals that kill and eat other animals) in a new fishery is reduced on average by 80% within 15 years of the start of exploitation.
fishery.translationZh: 根据他们发表在《自然》杂志上的最新论文，在新开发的渔场中，大型食肉鱼类（即捕食其他动物的鱼类）的生物量在开始捕捞后的15年内平均减少了80%。
fishery.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
fishery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

fishery.sentenceEn: Most fisheries are well below that, which is a bad way to do business.
fishery.translationZh: 大多数渔场的生物量远低于这一水平，这种经营方式非常糟糕。
fishery.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
fishery.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

fishery.sentenceEn: It has triggered a radical reform in commercial fisheries .
fishery.translationZh: 这引发了商业渔业的根本性改革。

forever.sentenceEn: Even Mark Twain, a man who enjoyed a hearty laugh, said that when it came to photographic portraits there could be "nothing more damning than a silly, foolish smile fixed forever ".
forever.translationZh: 即便是热爱开怀大笑的马克·吐温也说过，在摄影肖像中，'没有什么比永恒定格的愚蠢傻笑更糟糕的了'。
forever.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

forever.sentenceEn: A century ago Octavia Hill launched the National Trust not to rescue stylish houses but to save "the beauty of natural places for everyone forever ."
forever.translationZh: 一个世纪前，奥克塔维亚·希尔发起成立了国民信托组织，其目的并非拯救那些华丽的宅邸，而是为所有人永久保存“自然场所的美丽”。
forever.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

forever.sentenceEn: Hard times may hold you down at what usually seems like the most inopportune time, but you should remember that they won't last forever .
forever.translationZh: 艰难时刻似乎总在最不合时宜的时候将你困住，但请记住，它们不会永远持续下去。
forever.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

forever.sentenceEn: Yes, new technology has been eating jobs forever , and always will.
forever.translationZh: 诚然，新技术一直在吞噬就业岗位，而且这种趋势将持续下去。
forever.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

forever.sentenceEn: We need them to imagine the United States as a place where they can be productive for a while without committing themselves to staying forever .
forever.translationZh: 我们需要让他们将美国视为一个可以暂时发挥才干、无需承诺永久居留的地方。
forever.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

forever.sentenceEn: Keep Your Newspapers Forever in Fashion

frame.sentenceEn: A typical digital SLR camera shoots 20 frames a second.
frame.translationZh: 一款典型的数码单反相机每秒可拍摄20帧。

frame.sentenceEn: He uses a high-speed OM System which shoots 120 frames a second.
frame.translationZh: 他使用高速OM系统，该系统每秒可拍摄120帧。

frame.sentenceEn: After he's captured the butterfly taking off, he layers 10 to 15 frames together in Photoshop.
frame.translationZh: 在捕捉到蝴蝶起飞的瞬间后，他在Photoshop中将10到15帧画面叠加在一起。

frame.sentenceEn: A butterfly takes off so quickly it is still impossible to react quickly enough to capture that take-off but if he half-presses the shutter, the camera saves the 70 previous frames before the moment he actually takes the picture.
frame.translationZh: 蝴蝶起飞速度极快，快到让人来不及反应捕捉这一起飞瞬间，但如果他半按快门，相机就会保存他实际拍照前的70帧画面。

frame.sentenceEn: Peters' signature shot is a butterfly "take-off", showing the multiple wing-beats of one butterfly in one frame as it lifts off from a flower.
frame.translationZh: 彼得斯的标志性摄影作品是一种蝴蝶"起飞"照，在单张照片中捕捉了一只蝴蝶从花朵上起飞时的多次翅膀扇动。

frame.sentenceEn: "I don't believe that the legal protection would have happened in the time frame that it did without those images," says Heather Hansen, journalist and author of Prophets and Moguls, Rangers and Rogues, Bison and Bears: 100 Years of the National Park Service.
frame.translationZh: 记者兼《先知与大亨、护林员与流浪者、野牛与熊：国家公园管理局百年史》一书作者希瑟·汉森表示：“我认为，如果没有这些影像资料，黄石公园的法律保护不会在当时那个时间框架内实现。”

farming.sentenceEn: Britain has relatively few butterfly species compared with mainland Europe and 80% are in decline, mostly because intensive chemical farming has reduced many species to tiny fragments of habitat and small nature reserves.
farming.translationZh: 与欧洲大陆相比，英国的蝴蝶物种相对较少，其中80%的物种数量正在下降，这主要是因为集约化的化学农业将许多物种的栖息地缩减为零星的小块区域和小型自然保护区。

farming.sentenceEn: Such farming also brings minimal, if any, improvement to the food products (though some producers say their eggs have more protein).
farming.translationZh: 此类 farming 对食品本身的改善即便存在，也微乎其微（尽管一些生产商称其鸡蛋蛋白质含量更高）。
farming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

farming.sentenceEn: A move back to self-sufficiency, the argument goes, would boost the farming industry, political sovereignty and even the nation's health.
farming.translationZh: 支持者认为，恢复粮食自给自足将促进农业发展，增强政治主权，甚至改善国民健康。
farming.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

farming.sentenceEn: What is the much-argued solution to the labor shortage in U.S. farming ?
farming.translationZh: 美国农业劳动力短缺的备受争议的解决方案是什么？

farming.sentenceEn: For example, British anthropologists Grafton Elliot Smith and W. J. Perry incorrectly suggested, on the basis of inadequate information, that farming , pottery making, and metallurgy all originated in ancient Egypt and diffused throughout the world. In fact, all of these cultural developments occurred separately at different times in many parts of the world.
farming.translationZh: 例如，英国人类学家格拉夫顿·艾略特·史密斯和W.J.佩里基于不充分的资料错误地提出，农业、制陶术和冶金术都起源于古埃及，然后传播到世界各地。事实上，所有这些文化发展都是在世界不同地区于不同时期独立出现的。
farming.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）

feedback.sentenceEn: The fact your boss took the time to give you feedback at all means they care enough to want to help you improve.
feedback.translationZh: 你的老板愿意花时间给你提供反馈，这一事实本身就说明他们足够重视你，并希望帮助你进步。
feedback.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

feedback.sentenceEn: All good targets should have multiple criteria relating to critical factors such as time, money, quality and customer feedback .
feedback.translationZh: 所有良好的目标都应包含与关键因素相关的多重标准，例如时间、成本、质量和客户反馈。
feedback.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

feedback.sentenceEn: Positive feedback is important for anyone to hear.
feedback.translationZh: 听到积极的反馈对任何人来说都很重要。
feedback.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

feedback.sentenceEn: In it, a mother is asked to interact with her child in a normal way before putting on a blank expression and not giving them any visual social feedback : The child becomes increasingly distressed as she tries to capture her mother's attention.
feedback.translationZh: 在这个实验中，母亲被要求先以正常方式与孩子互动，然后摆出毫无表情的面孔，不给孩子任何视觉社交反馈：孩子在试图吸引母亲注意时会变得越来越苦恼。
feedback.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

feedback.sentenceEn: If you're not sure, ask for honest feedback from trusted friends, colleagues and professionals.
feedback.translationZh: 如果你不确定，可以向你信任的朋友、同事和专业人士征求坦诚的反馈。
feedback.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

feedback.sentenceEn: The program keeps track of your progress and provides detailed feedback on your performance and improvement.
feedback.translationZh: 该程序会追踪你的进步情况，并对你的表现和提升提供详细反馈。
feedback.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

file.sentenceEn: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy, which had largely been based on file uploads.
file.translationZh: 最初，像Netflix这样的合法在线企业的兴起实际上有助于遏制数字盗版，而当时的盗版主要以文件上传为基础。
file.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

file.sentenceEn: Have you ever stared helplessly at a ZIP disk, thinking: how do I get the files off this?
file.translationZh: 你是否曾无助地盯着一张ZIP磁盘，心想：我该如何把文件从这里导出来？
file.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

file.sentenceEn: As the rules came into effect last Wednesday, property developers were rushing to file plans just before the deadline.
file.translationZh: 随着新规于上周三正式生效，房地产开发商们纷纷赶在截止日期前提交规划申请。
file.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

file.sentenceEn: Builders which have costed projects, but have not filed the paperwork, may need to go back and submit fresh estimates, says Marcus Jefford of Build Aviator.
file.translationZh: Build Aviator公司的马库斯·杰福德表示，那些已经对项目进行了成本核算但尚未提交文件的建筑商，可能需要重新提交新的预算估算。
file.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

file.sentenceEn: Companies are unlikely to file many more patents for human DNA molecules – most are already patented or in the public domain.
file.translationZh: 各公司不太可能再为人类DNA分子申请更多专利——大多数DNA分子要么已被申请专利，要么已进入公共领域。
file.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

file.sentenceEn: In October the Department of Justice filed a brief in the Myriad case, arguing that an isolated DNA molecule "is no less a product of nature…than are cotton fibres that have been separated from cotton seeds."
file.translationZh: 10月，美国司法部就Myriad案提交了一份案情摘要，主张分离出的DNA分子“如同从棉籽中分离出的棉纤维一样，依然是自然的产物……”
file.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

finance.sentenceEn: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.
finance.translationZh: 英国公共财政与会计学会的一项年度调查显示，全英此类机构数量接近 800 家；而英格兰艺术委员会的官方统计数据记录，在英格兰仅有 230 家。
finance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

finance.sentenceEn: "It's not just about finances . The value of work is also driving folks to continue working past retirement."
finance.translationZh: 这不仅仅与经济因素有关。工作的价值也促使人们在退休后继续工作。
finance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

finance.sentenceEn: California plans to treat 35,000 acres of forest a year by 2020, and 60,000 by 2030 – financed from the proceeds of the state's emissions-permit auctions.
finance.translationZh: 加利福尼亚州计划到2020年每年治理35,000英亩森林，到2030年达到每年60,000英亩——资金来源于该州碳排放权拍卖的收益。
finance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

finance.sentenceEn: But Congress should look into doing so directly, by helping to finance PreCheck enrollment or to cut costs in other ways.
finance.translationZh: 但国会应直接考虑采取措施，通过资助预检计划的注册或通过其他方式降低成本。
finance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

finance.sentenceEn: For someone moving from finance to advertising, maybe they want to look more "SoHo."
finance.translationZh: 对于从金融行业转向广告行业的人来说，他们或许希望自己看起来更具“苏荷风格”。
finance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

finance.sentenceEn: This also involves the agreements between European countries for the creation of a European bank for Television Production which, on the model of the European Investments Bank, will handle the finances necessary for production costs.
finance.translationZh: 这也涉及到欧洲各国达成协议，建立一个欧洲电视制作银行。该银行将以欧洲投资银行为蓝本，负责处理制作成本所需的资金。
finance.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
finance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

flexibility.sentenceEn: "Millennials wanted more flexibility in their lives," notes Tanya Michelsen, Associate Director of YouthSight, a UK-based brand manager that conducts regular 60-day surveys of British youth, in findings that might just as well apply to American youth.
flexibility.translationZh: 英国品牌管理公司YouthSight的副总监Tanya Michelsen指出：'千禧一代希望生活有更大的灵活性。'该公司定期对英国年轻人进行为期60天的调查，其研究结果同样适用于美国年轻人。
flexibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

flexibility.sentenceEn: Fundamentally, the USPS is in a historic squeeze between technological change that has permanently decreased demand for its bread-and-butter product, first-class mail, and a regulatory structure that denies management the flexibility to adjust its operations to the new reality.
flexibility.translationZh: 从根本上讲，美国邮政署正处于历史性的双重挤压之中：一方面是技术变革永久性地降低了对其核心产品——一类邮件的需求，另一方面是监管结构剥夺了管理层调整业务以适应新现实的灵活性。
flexibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

flexibility.sentenceEn: While their parents were content to work long hours, young people value flexibility .
flexibility.translationZh: 虽然他们的父母满足于长时间工作，但年轻人更看重灵活性。
flexibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

flexibility.sentenceEn: But Ashe and others argued that the "threatened" tag gave the federal government flexibility to try out new, potentially less confrontational conservation approaches.
flexibility.translationZh: 但阿什等人认为，“受威胁”这一标签赋予联邦政府灵活性，可以尝试新的、可能对抗性更小的保护方法。
flexibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

flexibility.sentenceEn: The words that have mattered are efficiency, flexibility , shareholder value, business-friendly, wealth generation, sales, impact and, in newspapers, circulation.
flexibility.translationZh: 真正重要的词汇变成了效率、灵活性、股东价值、商业友好、财富创造、销售额、影响力，以及报纸行业的发行量。
flexibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

flexibility.sentenceEn: The communities minister, Don Foster, has hinted that George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, may introduce more flexibility to the current cap on the amount that local authorities can borrow against their housing stock debt.
flexibility.translationZh: 社区大臣唐·福斯特暗示，财政大臣乔治·奥斯本可能会对地方政府住房存量债务的借款额度现行上限采取更灵活的政策。
flexibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

foster.sentenceEn: Street festivals drive foot traffic to local businesses and foster the kind of cultural vibrancy that makes our city special.
foster.translationZh: 街头节庆活动不仅为当地商家带来了客流，也培育了使我们这座城市与众不同的文化活力。
foster.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

foster.sentenceEn: Not only will this foster political and social unrest, but it could, as Coyle suggests, hold back the sorts of AI technologies needed for regional economies to grow.
foster.translationZh: 这不仅会引发政治和社会动荡，正如科伊尔所指出的，还可能阻碍区域经济增长所需的各类人工智能技术的发展。
foster.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

foster.sentenceEn: Vocational schools should do a better job of fostering problem-solving skills and helping students work alongside robots.
foster.translationZh: 职业学校应当更好地培养学生的解决问题能力，并帮助他们学会与机器人协同工作。
foster.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

foster.sentenceEn: The communities minister, Don Foster , has hinted that George Osborne, Chancellor of the Exchequer, may introduce more flexibility to the current cap on the amount that local authorities can borrow against their housing stock debt.
foster.translationZh: 社区大臣唐·福斯特暗示，财政大臣乔治·奥斯本可能会对地方政府住房存量债务的借款额度现行上限采取更灵活的政策。
foster.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

foster.sentenceEn: "That's a lie that we have perpetuated, and it fosters commonness. Knowing what you're good at and doing even more of it creates excellence."
foster.translationZh: 这是我们一直以来延续的谎言，它助长了平庸。了解自己的优势所在并在此基础上再接再厉，才能成就卓越。
foster.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
foster.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

foster.sentenceEn: It fosters competition among citation providers.
foster.translationZh: 这助长了引文提供者之间的竞争。

frequent.sentenceEn: Instead, a growing body of research showed that frequent , low-severity fires made many ecosystems healthier.
frequent.translationZh: 相反，越来越多的研究表明，频繁且低烈度的火灾能让许多生态系统变得更加健康。
frequent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

frequent.sentenceEn: Disruptions have become increasingly frequent with train delays now a fixture in Italian media coverage.
frequent.translationZh: 交通中断已变得日益频繁，火车晚期现已成为意大利媒体报道中的常态。
frequent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

frequent.sentenceEn: Finally, assuming you're lost in an area humans tend to frequent , look for the marks we leave on the landscape.
frequent.translationZh: 最后，假设你在人类常去的区域迷了路，请寻找我们在地面上留下的痕迹。
frequent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

frequent.sentenceEn: Even among those who got a cold, the ones who felt greater social support and received more frequent hugs had less severe symptoms.
frequent.translationZh: 即便在那些患上感冒的人群中，获得更多社会支持且更常得到拥抱的人，其症状也较轻。
frequent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

frequent.sentenceEn: "If you and I parachuted back to Fortune 500 companies in 1990, we would see much less frequent use of terms like journey, mission, passion. There were goals, there were strategies, there were objectives, but we didn't talk about energy; we didn't talk about passion."
frequent.translationZh: 如果我们穿越回到1990年的《财富》500强公司，会发现当时"旅程"、"使命"、"激情"这类词汇的使用频率要低得多。那时候我们谈目标、谈战略、谈指标，但不会谈论干劲，也不会谈论激情。
frequent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

frequent.sentenceEn: In most of the homeless gardens of New York City the actual cultivation of plants is unfeasible, yet even so the compositions often seem to represent attempts to call forth the spirit of plant and animal life, if only symbolically, through a clumplike arrangement of materials, an introduction of colors, small pools of water, and a frequent presence of petals or leaves as well as of stuffed animals.
frequent.translationZh: 在纽约市大多数流浪者的花园中，实际培育植物是不现实的，但即便如此，这些花园的布局设计似乎常常试图唤醒动植物生命的精神——哪怕只是象征性地——通过材料的团块状排列、色彩的引入、小水池，以及频繁出现的花瓣、树叶和填充动物玩具。
frequent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

facility.sentenceEn: These fires were carefully planned and intentionally ignited during periods when weather kept the blazes easy to control, and helped eliminate some of the fuel that had built up around the important park's facilities .
facility.translationZh: 这些火灾是经过周密计划且有意点燃的。点火时段的天气状况使得火势易于控制，这有助于清除公园重要设施周边积聚的部分易燃物。
facility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

facility.sentenceEn: Issues arise, however, when developers attempt to create large-scale short-term rental facilities —de facto hotels—to bypass taxes and regulations.
facility.translationZh: 然而，当开发商试图建造大规模短期租赁设施——实际上就是酒店——以规避税收和法规时，问题就出现了。
facility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

facility.sentenceEn: A "town of culture" could be not just about the arts but about honouring a town's peculiarities—helping sustain its high street, supporting local facilities and above all celebrating its people.
facility.translationZh: "文化之镇"不仅关乎艺术，还在于彰显小镇的独特魅力——助力维持商业街活力，支持本地设施建设，最重要的是颂扬当地民众。
facility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

facility.sentenceEn: My own hospital system has banned sugary drinks from its facilities .
facility.translationZh: 我所在的医疗系统已在其所有设施内禁止销售含糖饮料。
facility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

facility.sentenceEn: they are unable to get sufficient facilities .
facility.translationZh: 他们无法获得充足的设施。

flaw.sentenceEn: Many argue that it is a flawed concept.
flaw.translationZh: 许多人认为这是一个有缺陷的概念。
flaw.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

flaw.sentenceEn: Since the beginning, this price tag has been PreCheck's fatal flaw .
flaw.translationZh: 从一开始，这一价格标签就成了预检计划的致命缺陷。
flaw.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

flaw.sentenceEn: The most glaring flaw of the social cure as it's presented here is that it doesn't work very well for very long.
flaw.translationZh: 正如书中所阐述的那样，这种社会疗法最明显的缺陷是其效果难以持久。
flaw.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

flaw.sentenceEn: Pushed by science, or what claims to be science, society is reclassifying what once were considered character flaws or moral failings as personality disorders akin to physical disabilities.
flaw.translationZh: 在科学（或者那些自称为科学的事物）的推动下，社会正将过去被视为性格缺陷或道德过失的问题重新归类为类似于身体残疾的人格障碍。
flaw.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
flaw.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

folk.sentenceEn: "It's not just about finances. The value of work is also driving folks to continue working past retirement."
folk.translationZh: 这不仅仅与经济因素有关。工作的价值也促使人们在退休后继续工作。
folk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

folk.sentenceEn: Within the span of a hundred years, in the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries, a tide of emigration – one of the great folk wanderings of history – swept from Europe to America.
folk.translationZh: 在17世纪至18世纪初的百年间，一股移民潮——历史上规模宏大的民众迁徙之一——从欧洲席卷至美洲。
folk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

folk.sentenceEn: Along with the many folks looking to make a permanent home in the United States came those who had no intention to stay, and who would make some money and then go home.
folk.translationZh: 在众多希望在美国永久定居的人群中，也有一些人并不打算留下来，他们只想赚些钱然后返回家乡。
folk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

folk.sentenceEn: Unhappy parents rarely are provoked to wonder if they shouldn't have had kids, but unhappy childless folks are bothered with the message that children are the single most important thing in the world: obviously their misery must be a direct result of the gaping baby-size holes in their lives.
folk.translationZh: 不幸福的父母很少会去反思自己当初是否不该要孩子，但不幸福的无子女者却总会被这样的观念所困扰：孩子是世界上最重要的东西。显然，他们的痛苦必定是生活中那个巨大的、婴儿大小的空洞直接造成的后果。
folk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

folk.sentenceEn: Meanwhile, many settlers had slighter religious commitments than Dane's, as one clergyman learned in confronting folk along the coast who mocked that they had not come to the New World for religion.
folk.translationZh: 与此同时，许多移民的宗教信仰远不如戴恩那般虔诚。正如一位牧师在与沿海居民交流时所了解到的，这些人嘲讽道，他们来新大陆并非为了宗教。
folk.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
folk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

folk.sentenceEn: Even before Alan Greenspan's admission that America's red-hot economy is cooling, lots of working folks had already seen signs of the slowdown themselves.
folk.translationZh: 甚至在艾伦·格林斯潘承认美国炽热的经济正在降温之前，许多劳动者自己就已经看到了经济放缓的迹象。
folk.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
folk.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

foundation.sentenceEn: "Elephants never forget"—or so they say—and that piece of folklore seems to have some foundation .
foundation.translationZh: 人们常说“大象永远不会忘记”——而这一民间说法似乎确有一定依据。
foundation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

foundation.sentenceEn: A Knight Foundation focus-group survey of young people between ages 14 and 24 found they use "distributed trust" to verify stories.
foundation.translationZh: 奈特基金会针对14至24岁年轻人开展的焦点小组调查发现，他们会运用"分布式信任"来验证新闻故事的真伪。
foundation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

foundation.sentenceEn: The history of the EEOB began long before its foundations were laid.
foundation.translationZh: 艾森豪威尔行政办公大楼的历史远在其奠基石铺设之前就已开始。

foundation.sentenceEn: He could not confide them even to his wife, although they provide the unacknowledged foundation of his fiction.
foundation.translationZh: 他甚至无法向自己的妻子吐露这些经历，尽管它们构成了他小说创作中未被承认的基础。

foundation.sentenceEn: But the Nobel Foundation's limit of three recipients per prize, each of whom must still be living, has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research – as will be demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored when it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson.
foundation.translationZh: 但诺贝尔基金会限制每个奖项最多只能有三位获奖者，且每位获奖者必须在世，这一规定早已不再适应现代科研的协作性质——这一点将在希格斯玻色子发现的功劳归属问题上得到印证，届时必将出现关于哪些人被忽视的争议。
foundation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

foundation.sentenceEn: In 2010, leading congressional Democrats and Republicans sent letters to the AAAS asking that it identify actions that could be taken by "federal, state and local governments, universities, foundations , educators, individual benefactors and others" to "maintain national excellence in humanities and social scientific scholarship and education."
foundation.translationZh: 2010年，美国国会民主党与共和党领袖联名致函美国人文与科学院（AAAS），要求其明确“联邦、州和地方政府、大学、基金会、教育工作者、个人捐助者及其他相关方”可采取哪些行动，以“保持美国在人文与社会科学学术研究及教育领域的卓越地位”。
foundation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

faith.sentenceEn: On the other hand, putting your faith in the wrong place often carries a high price.
faith.translationZh: 另一方面，错信他人往往会付出高昂的代价。
faith.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

faith.sentenceEn: Markets have lost faith that the euro zone's economies, weaker or stronger, will one day converge thanks to the discipline of sharing a single currency, which denies uncompetitive members the quick fix of devaluation.
faith.translationZh: 市场已经失去信心，不再相信欧元区经济体——无论强弱——会因为共用单一货币的约束而有朝一日实现趋同，因为单一货币制度使缺乏竞争力的成员国无法通过货币贬值这一捷径来解决问题。
faith.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

faith.sentenceEn: While most leaders sought to maintain Catholicism as the official religion of the new states, some sought to end the exclusion of other faiths .
faith.translationZh: 尽管大多数领导人希望将天主教保留为新国家的官方宗教，但也有一些领导人试图结束对其他宗教信仰的排斥。
faith.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
faith.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

faith.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）

forecast.sentenceEn: With the global population predicted to hit close to 10 billion by 2050, and forecasts that agricultural production in some regions will need to nearly double to keep pace, food security is increasingly making headlines.
forecast.translationZh: 预计到2050年全球人口将接近100亿，而据预测，部分地区的农业产量需接近翻倍才能跟上这一增长步伐，粮食安全问题因此日益成为新闻焦点。
forecast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

forecast.sentenceEn: But policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.
forecast.translationZh: 但如果政策制定者能将精力重新集中在改善民众福祉上，而非仅仅纠结于GDP数据，就能避免预测中的厄运，甚至可能看到进步。
forecast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

forecast.sentenceEn: As so often, the past holds the key to the future: we have now identified enough of the long-term patterns shaping the history of the planet, and our species, to make evidence-based forecasts about the situations in which our descendants will find themselves.
forecast.translationZh: 正如常常出现的情况，过去是打开未来之门的钥匙：我们现在已经识别出足够多塑造地球和我们物种历史的长期模式，从而能够对我们后代将面临的处境做出基于证据的预测。
forecast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

forecast.sentenceEn: A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision, ruling that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes that help forecast a woman's risk of breast cancer.
forecast.translationZh: 一家联邦上诉法院推翻了先前的判决，裁定Myriad Genetics公司确实可以拥有两项基因的专利，这两项基因有助于预测女性患乳腺癌的风险。
forecast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

forecast.sentenceEn: Despite a spell of initial optimism in the 1960s and 1970s when it appeared that transistor circuits and microprocessors might be able to copy the action of the human brain by the year 2010, researchers lately have begun to extend that forecast by decades if not centuries.
forecast.translationZh: 尽管在20世纪60年代和70年代曾有过一段最初的乐观时期——当时人们似乎认为晶体管电路和微处理器到2010年或许能够复制人脑的活动——但研究人员最近已开始将这一预测延后数十年，甚至数百年。
forecast.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
forecast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

forecast.sentenceEn: However, there are still no forecasts for when faster-than-light travel will be available, or when human cloning will be perfected, or when time travel will be possible.
forecast.translationZh: 然而，对于超光速旅行何时能实现、人类克隆何时能完善，或是时间旅行何时能成为可能，目前仍无预测。
forecast.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
forecast.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

forgiveness.sentenceEn: Grade forgiveness allows students to retake a course in which they received a low grade, and the most recent grade or the highest grade is the only one that counts in calculating a student's overall GPA.
forgiveness.translationZh: 成绩宽恕政策允许学生重修曾获得低分的课程，而在计算学生的总平均绩点时，只计入最近一次的成绩或最高成绩。
forgiveness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

forgiveness.sentenceEn: That said, there is a way in which grade forgiveness satisfies colleges' own needs as well.
forgiveness.translationZh: 话虽如此，成绩宽恕政策在某种程度上也满足了大学自身的需求。
forgiveness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

forgiveness.sentenceEn: Indeed, grade forgiveness is just another way that universities are responding to consumers' expectations for higher education.
forgiveness.translationZh: 事实上，成绩宽恕只是大学回应消费者对高等教育期望的另一种方式。
forgiveness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

forgiveness.sentenceEn: College officials tend to emphasize that the goal of grade forgiveness is less about the grade itself and more about encouraging students to retake courses critical to their degree program and graduation without incurring a big penalty.
forgiveness.translationZh: 大学管理人员往往强调，分数宽恕的目的不在于分数本身，而更多是为了鼓励学生重修那些对其学位课程和毕业至关重要的课程，同时不会因此受到严重惩罚。
forgiveness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

forgiveness.sentenceEn: But another, related force – a policy often buried deep in course catalogs called "grade forgiveness " – is helping raise GPAs.
forgiveness.translationZh: 但另一个相关因素——一项常被深藏在课程目录中的政策，称为“成绩宽恕”——正在助长平均绩点的上升。
forgiveness.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

forgiveness.sentenceEn: What was the original purpose of grade forgiveness ?
forgiveness.translationZh: 分数宽恕的最初目的是什么？

frustration.sentenceEn: This proposed mandate was born of frustration .
frustration.translationZh: 这项拟议的强制规定源于一种失望情绪。
frustration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

frustration.sentenceEn: I understand Reding's reluctance – and her frustration .
frustration.translationZh: 我理解雷丁的不情愿——也理解她的失望。
frustration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

frustration.sentenceEn: Sexual confusion, economic frustrations , and religious hope – all came together in a decisive moment when he opened the Bible, told his father that the first line he saw would settle his fate, and read the magical words: "Come out from among them, touch no unclean thing, and I will be your God and you shall be my people."
frustration.translationZh: 性的困惑、经济上的挫折以及宗教信仰——所有这些在他翻开《圣经》的那一刻汇聚成了一个决定性的时刻。他告诉父亲，自己看到的第一行经文将决定他的命运，然后读到了那句具有魔力的话语：“你们务要从他们中间出来，不要沾不洁净的物，我就收纳你们。我要作你们的神，你们要作我的子民。”
frustration.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
frustration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

frustration.sentenceEn: "I struggled a lot to get the college degree. I was living in so much frustration that that was my escape, to go to school, and get ahead and do better."
frustration.translationZh: 为了获得大学学位，我付出了巨大的努力。当时我生活在极度的沮丧中，因此上学、不断进步、做得更好就成了我的逃避方式。
frustration.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
frustration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

frustration.sentenceEn: Other identifiable causes of offensive acts include frustration or failure in school, the increased availability of drugs and alcohol, and the growing incidence of child abuse and child neglect.
frustration.translationZh: 其他可确定的犯罪行为诱因包括：在学校遭遇挫折或学业失败、毒品和酒精的获取渠道增加，以及虐待和忽视儿童事件的发生率上升。
frustration.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
frustration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

frustration.sentenceEn: " Frustration against this kind of thing leads kids to drop out and run wild."
frustration.translationZh: 对这类事情的不满导致孩子们辍学并变得行为失控。
frustration.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
frustration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

futurist.sentenceEn: This, though it fulfills the laws and requirements of Futurist poetry, can hardly be classed as Literature.
futurist.translationZh: 尽管这符合未来主义诗歌的规则和要求，但它很难被归类为文学。
futurist.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
futurist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

futurist.sentenceEn: This, in brief, is what the Futurist says: for a century, past conditions of life have been conditionally speeding up, till now we live in a world of noise and violence and speed.
futurist.translationZh: 简而言之，未来主义者的主张是这样的：一个世纪以来，过去的生活状况一直在有条件地加速变化，直至今日我们生活在一个充满喧嚣、暴力与速度的世界。
futurist.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
futurist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

futurist.sentenceEn: With regard to Futurist poetry, however, the case is rather difficult, for whatever Futurist poetry may be—even admitting that the theory on which it is based may be right—it can hardly be classed as Literature.
futurist.translationZh: 然而，就未来主义诗歌而言，情况却相当复杂。因为无论未来主义诗歌为何物——即便我们承认其理论基础可能正确——它也很难被归类为文学。
futurist.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
futurist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

futurist.sentenceEn: This speeding up of life, says the Futurist , requires a new form of expression.
futurist.translationZh: 未来主义者认为，这种生活节奏的加快需要新的表达方式。
futurist.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
futurist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句
